Launch shell in a per-project sandbox

Usage: agent-vm shell [OPTIONS] [AGENT_ARGS]...

Arguments:
  [AGENT_ARGS]...  Args passed verbatim to the agent; use -- before any agent flags

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help (see more with '--help')

Sandbox resources:
      --memory <GIB>  Sandbox memory, in GiB [env: AGENT_VM_MEMORY_GIB] [default: 2]
      --cpus <N>      vCPU count for the sandbox [env: AGENT_VM_CPUS] [default: 2]

GitHub access:
      --no-git             Don't inject host gh/git credentials into the guest
      --repo <OWNER/REPO>  Add a repo to the GitHub allow-list (repeatable)

Credentials:
      --allow-missing-credentials  Launch even when a requested YAML credential is missing or
                                   unreadable

Mounts & ports:
      --mount <HOST[:GUEST][:MODE]...>
          Bind an extra host path into the guest, or seed a persistent fork (repeatable)
  -p, --publish <[BIND:]HOST_PORT:GUEST_PORT>
          Publish a guest TCP port to the host, docker-style (repeatable)
      --auto-publish
          Auto-forward every guest listener onto the host (Lima-style)

Network egress:
      --allow-egress <[tcp://|udp://]IP|CIDR[:PORT]>
          Allow one IP/CIDR, optionally narrowed by tcp:// or udp:// and :PORT (repeatable)
      --allow-internet-egress[=<BOOL>]
          Allow public internet egress and DNS. Guest egress is denied by default [possible values:
          true, false]
      --allow-lan[=<BOOL>]
          Allow Private RFC1918, 100.64/10 and fc00::/7. Does not itself grant internet or DNS
          [possible values: true, false]
      --allow-host[=<BOOL>]
          Allow host loopback services through host.microsandbox.internal, including the host DNS
          resolver. Does not itself grant internet [possible values: true, false]

Image:
      --image <REF>   Boot this image instead of the configured one [env: AGENT_VM_IMAGE_TAG]
      --update-check  Check the registry for a newer image at launch (opt-in)

Guest user:
      --root  Run the guest as root (uid 0) instead of the default host user

Examples:
  agent-vm shell                  launch in the current project
  agent-vm shell -p 8080:3000     publish guest :3000 to host 127.0.0.1:8080
  agent-vm shell -- --some-flag   forward args to the tool (after --)

Trailing args go to the tool. Run with --help for networking, security, and env details.
